## IBrokerTransportConfig.authScheme property

Authorization scheme prefix for the token.

Use `'Basic'` for Pinot v1 and `'Bearer'` for Pinot v2.

**Signature:**

```typescript
authScheme?: 'Basic' | 'Bearer';
```

## Default Value

'Basic'
